target_market: Ireland, Spain, Portugal, Romania, Brazil, Czechia
locale_scope: consolidate onto each market's own locale
proposed_page_family: locale consolidation of clusters whose winning URL is on the WRONG locale - ZERO new URLs; this is a reduction, not a family
existing_inventory_check: The inventory is 6 markets x 6 locales (pt 516, en 512, es 501, cs 441, ro 440, de 440 pages): the site is already over-programmatised, with 2,118 canonical candidates but only ~955 URLs earning any impression. cannibalisation.csv: 375 of 591 clusters are wrong_locale, carrying 8,066 impr / 86 clicks. 157 of those clusters (1,546 impr, 1 click) have their WINNING URL on a locale that is not the market's own - Romania 43 clusters, Spain 37, Ireland 31, Portugal 24, Brazil 12, Czechia 10.
validated_demand: yes - and it is demand MGH already holds and is misrouting. Named cases: psiquiatra online 93 impr won by /spain/pt/services/psiquiatra-online (a Portuguese page for a Spanish query, pos 59); consulta online saude masculina 52 impr won by /brazil/de/services/saude-do-homem-online (a GERMAN page, pos 20); cita medico 58 impr and consulta online 45 impr won by /portugal/es/services/consulta-medica; sick cert ireland + sick cert online + sick note online + medical certificate ireland + sick certificate online = 243 impr, all five won by the legacy /ireland/sick-leave lander while /ireland/en/services/sick-certificate-ireland sits at pos 40.
unique_data_available: n/a - no new content is written. The work is hreflang, canonical and internal-link correction plus a decision on the legacy lander.
local_usefulness: high - each market gets its own language back.
distinct_intent: yes - each locale variant already claims a distinct audience; today Google picks the wrong one.
source_ownership: code (routing, hreflang, canonicals) + CMS for the legacy lander
duplicate_risk: low - this REMOVES duplicate contention rather than adding it
internal_link_placement: market_home and the services hub already link these; the change is that internal links from a market point only at that market's own locale, so the non-own-locale variants stop competing
indexing_canonical_policy: index primary locale only for the 12 clusters in scope; every locale variant stays self-canonical and indexable - no mass noindex of locale variants (forbidden by S27.5)
measurable_purpose: recover the 1,546 impressions currently landing on wrong-locale URLs onto own-locale URLs and convert the 0 clicks those 157 clusters produce today; target >=15 clicks/month across the 12 pilot clusters within 90 days
launch_decision: PILOT - the highest-evidence candidate of the eight, it publishes zero new pages, and it directly implements A7 cross-market finding #1 plus the Ireland, Romania and Brazil achievable lists
publication_gates: (1) confirm live serving and hreflang reciprocity on all 12 before touching anything - hreflang is emitted camelCase as hrefLang, so grep for hrefLang, not hreflang; (2) no locale variant is noindexed (S27.5 forbids mass noindex of locale variants); (3) /ireland/sick-leave keeps a 200 or a 308 and never a 404 - it holds pos 2 for sick cert ireland; (4) nothing lands until the Ireland lab-tests 404 (PS-04) is triaged, since that is a live regression competing for the same attention; (5) refresh GSC for the 12 clusters immediately before the change, per the CLAUDE.md pre-batch rule
rollback_criteria: revert if, 30 days after the change, own-locale impressions across the 12 clusters sit below the pre-change wrong-locale baseline (1,546 impr) minus 20%; OR if any of the 12 loses its best_position by more than 10 places; OR if /ireland/sick-leave loses its pos-2 ranking for sick cert ireland
post_indexation_measurement_window: 30 / 60 / 90 days measured from the first post-change crawl recorded in url_inspection - index state, not deploy date, because Google's index state is not production state
success_metric: primary: >=15 clicks/month across the 12 clusters at 90 days (today 0). secondary: at 60 days, >=8 of the 12 clusters show their own-locale URL as top_url in a re-run of cannibalisation.csv
